questions.explanation: ~ 때문에 (접속사)

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage: ______________ the wind was blowing, it wasn't very cold.
choices: As if
Because
Although
When
Since
questions.explanation: though, although, even though는 양보의 부사절을 이끄는 접속사로 '주어+동사'의 절을 이끈다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.passage: ______________ he had a terrible car accident, he wasn't hurt at all.
choices: Since
Though
Although
Even though
Until
questions.explanation: though, although, even though는 양보의 부사절을 이끄는 접속사로 '주어+동사'의 절을 이끈다.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르면?
questions.passage:
We had a lot of snow last week, so the streets were still slippery.
= ___________ we had a lot of snow last week, the streets were still slippery.
choices: If
When
Since
Although
While
questions.explanation: ~ 때문에 (접속사)

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?
choices: though he is too old
because of his old age
as he is too young
since he is sick in bed
unless he is too old.
questions.explanation: though (비록) ~이긴 하지만, unless ~하지 않는 한.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.passage:
• (A)_________ the weather is so bad, I'm not going out today.
• (B)_________ Betty left me 20 years ago, I still miss her.
• (C)__________ it was raining, we continued playing soccer.
choices: (A) Since / (B) While / (C) As
(A) Although / (B) But / (C) Because
(A) Though / (B) Though / (C) Although
(A) As / (B) But / (C) But
(A) Since / (B) Though / (C) Even though
questions.explanation: (A) 주절의 이유를 나타내는 because[as/since]가 적절하다. (B), (C) '비록 ~일지라도'라는 뜻의 접속사 (al)though, even though가 올바르다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.passage:
• I got up late ________ I had a bad cold.
• ________ I was late, I went to the meeting.
• I have studied English ______ I was five years old.
• ________ the food gets into the river, the water quickly becomes dirty.
• I don't like hamburgers _______ they're bad for my health.
choices: once
since
although
because
however
questions.explanation: I got up late since/because I had a bad cold. / Although I was late, I went to the meeting. / I have studied English since I was five years old. / Once the food gets into the river ~ / I don't like hamburgers since/because they're bad for my health.

questions.prompt:
다음 우리말을 알맞게 영작한 것을 모두 고르면?
Mary는 높은 열 때문에 병원에 입원했다.
choices: Since Mary had a high fever, she went into the hospital.
Because a high fever, Mary went into the hospital.
Though Mary had a high fever, she went into the hospital.
Because of a high fever, Mary went into the hospital.
Mary had a high fever because she went into the hospital.
questions.explanation: Because[As, Since] S+V, Because of+명사(구). ③과 ⑤는 의미상 올바르지 않다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
choices: [[Because of]] his disease, he can't come to school.
[[Despite]] her strengths, she got the first prize.
[[Since]] he was ill, he couldn't come to the party.
[[Thanks to]] his help, we could finish it with success.
[[Even if]] he is sick, he does his best all the time.
questions.explanation: despite는 '~임에도 불구하고'라는 뜻으로 보기 문맥에는 맞지 않다. 이유를 나타내는 전치사 because of가 들어가야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
choices: [[Since]] I studied hard, I passed the exam.
Everybody likes James [[since]] he is generous.
[[Although]] it was cold outside, they wore shorts.
[[Although]] he is very young, he acts like an old man.
They didn't believe him [[since]] he was telling the truth.
questions.explanation: 그가 진실을 말하고 있음에도 사람들이 그를 믿어주지 않았다는 내용이 되어야 하므로 although를 써야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어가 문맥상 올바른 것은?
choices: [[Since]] I have no money, I cannot buy the snack.
My mom cooked dinner [[although]] we were hungry.
She couldn't get good grades [[since]] she studied very hard.
[[Although]] I wear glasses, I can read all the letters with them.
[[Since]] coke is not good for our health, the doctor advised me to drink it every day.
questions.explanation: ② 문맥상 since가 들어가야 한다. ③ 문맥상 although가 들어가야 한다. ④ 문맥상 Since가 들어가야 한다. ⑤ 문맥상 Although가 들어가야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Since John is our friend, he'll help us.
He went to bed early since he was sick.
Since it's raining outside, I'll stay at home.
She got up late since she missed the school bus.
Since tomorrow is Sunday, I don't have to get up early.
questions.explanation: → She missed the school bus since she got up late.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?
choices: We went on a picnic though it was rainy.
She failed the test even though she had studied hard.
He is strong and healthy though he is seventy years old.
She couldn't eat the meal though she was very hungry.
He didn't go to school even though he was sick.
questions.explanation: 의미상 even though보다는 이유를 나타내는 접속사가 들어가야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: I'm hungry ________ I didn't eat lunch.
I didn't go out ________ the bad weather.
We like her ________ she is very kind to us.
Jenny couldn't walk ________ she broke her leg.
Hajun got up late ________ he stayed up late last night.
questions.explanation: because of (전치사), 나머지는 since (접속사).

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: _______ they are poor, they're happy.
I will do my best _______ the problem is very difficult.
_______ it was cold, they played outside.
_______ she is young, she is very brave.
_______ I got up late, I was late for school.
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 접속사가 들어가야 한다. 나머지는 모두 '~임에도 불구하고'란 뜻의 although가 들어가야 한다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: _______ it rained, they went jogging.
I couldn't sleep _______ I was tired.
_______ the traffic was heavy, I arrived late.
_______ he didn't study much, he passed the test.
It is pretty warm _______ it is a little windy.
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 접속사가 들어가야 한다. 나머지는 모두 '~임에도 불구하고'란 뜻의 although가 들어간다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 다른 하나는?
choices: They often die from eating plastic _____________ their bodies cannot break it down.
She can't find the way _____________ she is a new student.
_____________ everyone's busy, we'll cancel the meeting.
He plays basketball very well _____________ he is tall.
_____________ Korea is a small country, it has a long history.
questions.explanation: ⑤번에는 though[although]가 들어간다. 나머지는 because/since/as가 들어간다.

questions.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 다른 하나는?
choices: We've played better ______ you joined our team.
______ the party, she hasn't spoken to him at all.
______ the Earth is rotating, two tides occur each day.
I felt hungry, ______ I made myself a sandwich.
I left school in 1995, and ______ then I've lived in London.
questions.explanation: ④번에는 so가 들어간다. 나머지는 since. (①, ②, ⑤ ~ 이후로, ③ ~ 때문에).

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He wore a short T-shirt _______ it was freezing.
I had a headache _______ I stayed up all night.
They put on sunglasses _______ it was really dark.
I'll buy a brand new car _______ it's so expensive.
She always passes her exams _______ she does not study at all.
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 접속사 since 또는 because가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 although가 들어간다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: I can sleep _______ it's very noisy.
I don't like him _______ he isn't honest.
_______ it was raining, I didn't get wet.
_______ she is pretty, she isn't content with her face.
I was late for school _______ I got up early in the morning.
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 접속사 since 또는 because가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 although가 들어간다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 Since가 들어가기에 적절하지 않은 문장은?
choices: ________ you're late, you can't watch the musical.
________ the food is not tasty, you'd better say nice things to the cook.

questions.explanation: 음식이 맛이 없어도 요리사에게 좋은 말을 하는 게 낫다는 의미이므로 빈칸에는 Although가 적합하다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: _______ what she cooked wasn't tasty, I ate it all.
We played soccer _______ it was raining outside.

questions.explanation: because[since/as] ~ 때문에, 나머지는 though[although/even though].

questions.explanation: because[since/as] ~ 때문에, 나머지는 though[although/even though].

questions.prompt:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 <보기>와 다른 것은?
<보기> I enjoy reading books [[since]] it helps me to be creative.
choices: He did not go [[since]] he was ill.
I must stop now [[since]] I have to go out.
I'll buy you popcorn [[since]] you paid for coke.
We have been friends [[since]] we were 13 years old.
[[Since]] I've just started learning Chinese, I can't speak Chinese well.
questions.explanation: ④번 since는 '~한 이래로, 이후로'. 나머지는 '~ 때문에'.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 같은 용법이 아닌 것은?
questions.passage: [[Since]] the traffic was heavy, we arrived late.
choices: I can't go out [[since]] it's raining cats and dogs.
We went on a picnic [[since]] it was a bright and sunny day.
My back has been bad ever [[since]] I fell and hurt it.
[[Since]] I caught a cold, I couldn't attend the meeting.
We should go home early [[since]] it is getting dark.
questions.explanation: ③번 since는 '~이후로'. 나머지는 '~때문에'.

questions.prompt:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 <보기>와 같은 것은? (정답 2개)
<보기> He is excited [[since]] his soccer team won the championship.
choices: [[Since]] it was very cold, we wore warm clothes.
She has been worried ever [[since]] the letter arrived.
It's been 10 years [[since]] we graduated from high school.
The two people have hated each other [[since]] they met for the first time.
We thought that [[since]] we were in the area, we'd stop by and see them.
questions.explanation: ~ 때문에. 나머지는 ~ 이래로, 이후로.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: The ice cream is melting [[as]] the weather is hot.
The baby is crying [[because]] she is hungry.
[[As]] she got up too early, she is sleepy now.
He wears glasses every day [[since]] he has bad sight.
[[Since]] he was at age 6, he has been in Seoul.
questions.explanation: ⑤번 since는 '~ 이래로, 이후로'. 나머지는 '~ 때문에'.

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
questions.passage: [[Since]] my sister lied to me, I was angry at her.
choices: [[Since]] she became busy with her work, she had to hire a baby sitter.
I tipped the clerk $50 [[since]] he treated me well.
[[Since]] there was the storm, our fence fell down.
The building has been there [[since]] my last visit.
She couldn't understand the point [[since]] he spoke so fast.
questions.explanation: ④번 since는 '~ 이후로'. 나머지는 '~때문에'.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: [[Since]] it was Friday, I stayed up late.
I haven't heard from him [[since]] last year.
[[Since]] I had a bad cold, I stayed at home all day long.
[[Since]] I'm very tired, I'm going to go to bed right away.
We don't have to go to school [[since]] tomorrow is a holiday.
questions.explanation: ② since는 '~ 이래로, 이후로'. 나머지는 '~ 때문에'.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: [[Since]] we have no money, we can't buy it.
I'll do the dishes tonight [[since]] you cooked.
[[Since]] then, it has become more and more popular.
I wanted to sleep some more [[since]] I was not well.
He didn't attend the meeting yesterday [[since]] he was sick.
questions.explanation: ③번 since는 '~ 이래로, 이후로'. 나머지는 '~ 때문에'.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: Take your umbrella [[since]] it's raining outside.
Mike didn't come to school [[since]] he had a cold.
You should cook dinner [[since]] you're a good cook.
He has been sick [[since]] he graduated from university.
I couldn't buy the book [[since]] I used up my allowance.
questions.explanation: ④번의 since는 '~한 이후로'라는 뜻으로 사용되었고, 나머지 보기는 모두 이유를 나타내는 접속사로 사용되었다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices: [[Since]] Jane came home late, her dad was worried about her.
I was waiting for him inside the cafe [[since]] it was very cold outside.
[[Since]] Judy is kind, everyone likes her.
It has been a couple of years [[since]] she left me.
He couldn't buy a car [[since]] he didn't have enough money.
questions.explanation: ④번 since ~ 이후로. 나머지는 '때문에'의 의미.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 의미가 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.passage:
ⓐ Minho was absent today [[since]] he was sick.
ⓑ Sujin will help me [[since]] she is my best friend.
ⓒ I have studied English [[since]] I was ten years old.
ⓓ He likes this town [[since]] people are very polite and kind.
ⓔ She has lived in Seoul [[since]] she was nineteen.
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓓ ~ 때문에. ⓒ, ⓔ ~ 이래로, 이후로.
